title: Deltarune Weapons
description: This mod simply adds weapons from the game Deltarune
body:
This mod aims to add weaponry from the game Deltarune to Minecraft.
Currently as of 1.0 Release there are only 2 weapons, Black Shard and Devil's Knife

Black Shard
![Black Shard Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5b92d627326715d8fec0be0cb2ad3d812b4d8b20_0.webp)
Crafted using a Nether Star and Tinted Glass it is an extremely fast and hard hitting sword.

Devil's Knife
![Devil's Knife Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9e112a21b0b7a3dde8779a0a92afa70a3a21d1f6.png)
Crafted using Diamond Gold Amethyst and Netherite, it is stronger and slower than a Netherite Sword and a tiny bit faster and stronger than a Netherite Axe.
It serves as a faster swinging axe with a little bit more damage. Perfect for those who find the sword too weak and the axe too clunky.




What to expect in the future?


I want the Black Shard to keep its tremendous speed and damage as to stay consistent with the canon material, but i am not oblivious to just how much better it is than any other weapon by a mile.

For this reason I thought of using Netherite Ingots in its recipe instead but that again wouldnt be fitting to the canon.

And I want there to be more of a reason to explore so i wanna make it require niche items.

I plan to somehow include Netherite Ingots and Prismarine or Echo Shards, maybe even both.
Requiring to combine Tinted Glass and Netherite could be a good idea.
